title: Super Bowl XXXII
overview: Super Bowl XXXII, played on January 25, 1998, at Qualcomm Stadium in San Diego, delivered one of the most thrilling upsets in Super Bowl history as the Denver Broncos defeated the defending champion Green Bay Packers 31-24. The victory ended the AFC’s 13-year Super Bowl losing streak and gave John Elway his long-awaited first championship after three previous Super Bowl defeats.
